prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Tennessine (테네신) itself — the sovereign of the Tennessine Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a fierce, wild ferocity; light honey-beige skin; face with soft jaw angles that taper gently toward a rounded chin, not wide from the front; eyes on the smaller side of natural — smooth monolid eyes of natural size, outer eye corners slightly lifted; thin straight brows; a nose with a soft, rounded tip, of natural size; thin lips with a defined cupid's bow; yellow-green chartreuse eyes; a thin faint scar through one eyebrow.
Body and hair: petite, small-framed build; a huge mane of voluminous curls with long bangs falling over one eye; smoky blue hair layered in receding bands like ridge after ridge of hazy mountains, darkening to deep slate at the tips.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Her element, carried in her design: tennessine: a synthetic superheavy element, the heaviest in the halogen column, first made in 2010 by firing calcium ions at a target of berkelium, twenty-two milligrams of it cooked for about two hundred and fifty days in a research reactor across the ocean; racing the target's own decay, the sealed shipment was turned back at customs twice for missing papers and crossed the ocean five times; named for a land of winding rivers, blue-hazed mountains and string-band music where its makers worked; though its name ends like fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine and astatine, it is predicted to grasp least of all its kin, closer to a metal than a true halogen.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Separate smoky mountain-blue and river-slate armor pieces at the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins over a dark halogen-violet fitted inner suit, each piece clasped on with small hooked grips like a hand that will not let go, thin taut glowing lines strung between the pieces like the strings of an instrument, a warm amber core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: smoky mountain blue, river slate grey, dark halogen violet, warm fiddle-wood amber.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city of dams stepping down a great river: vast dams whose spillways hum low like plucked strings whenever the water runs over, a reactor research station below them with a pool glowing blue, and a launch field for cargo shuttles that carry a single sealed capsule across the ocean.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ts) and atomic number (117) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
